from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1'
assert not OUT.exists(),'E16来源目录已经存在，必须先核现有阶段，禁止覆盖。'
parent=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1/next_experiment.json'
proposal=json.loads(parent.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E16' and proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
parents=[
'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1/next_experiment.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1/model_protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1/model_freeze.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_price_decomposition_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_price_decomposition_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_funding_quantity_price_bridge_v12/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_funding_quantity_price_bridge_v12/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet']
for record in proposal['old_source_records']:assert sha(ROOT/record['path'])==record['sha256']
old=json.loads((ROOT/parents[4]).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert 'AAA票据3年' in old['mechanical_identity']
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
protocol={'study_id':'510300_BANK_ACCEPTED_BILL_DISCOUNT_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E16',
'registered_at':now,'phase':'BOUNDED_OFFICIAL_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_ONLY',
'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E15_FIXED_INCREMENT_REJECTED_AND_FACTS_SAVED',
'question':proposal['question'],'research_unit':'510300指数整体国内信用定价原因；不是个股研究',
'target_instrument':proposal['target_instrument'],'target_tenor':'六个月剩余期限；不事后改期限',
'target_rate':'国有与股份制银行承兑的电子银行承兑汇票转贴现收益率；先核官方字段名称、年化口径与单位',
'not_substitutable_sources':proposal['not_substitutable_sources'],
'why_different':proposal['difference_from_frozen_failures'],
'information_role':proposal['candidate_information_role'],
'historical_scope':['2022-01-01','2025-12-31'],
'entry_domains_to_authenticate':['shcpe.com.cn','shcpe.com'],
'entry_urls':['https://www.shcpe.com.cn/','http://www.shcpe.com.cn/','https://www.shcpe.com/','http://www.shcpe.com/'],
'entry_probe_budget':4,'additional_official_requests_budget':12,'official_catalog_search_budget':4,
'request_attempts_each':1,'request_timeout_seconds':{'connect':10,'read':25},'maximum_network_workers':3,
'source_identity':'需要官方主体页和监管/官方基础设施链接互证；机构名称相似或搜索自称官网不算认证。未认证仿站不进入历史输入。',
'source_route':'先原入口与目录/方法说明，再仅沿页内发现的正式历史查询/数据接口；不猜年份镜像、不下载全市场文件、不接收费账户、不读取今天利率形成观点。',
'publication_clock':'核原正式发布规则与历史记录公布日期/时刻；只有原规则支持的保守上界才能连接历史决定。统计日期或今天HTTP时间不自动替代历史首次公布。历史首版未证实时明确保留。',
'coverage_gate':'必须有目标同期限同承兑类型的2022—2025连续历史及合法可知时钟才准入模型；未知不补零、不用事后年图。仅入口/样例通过不足以称历史全覆盖。',
'first_probe_success_stop':'若不存在可认证官方入口或原历史路径，结束此有限来源问题；不以第三方报价或更换品种营救。',
'model_registration':'来源合格后另登记一个字段的同事件同成熟池固定比较；本协议不登记模型、不读取新股票分组收益。',
'search_selection_disclosure':'此前搜索摘要/未认证域名线索已看到，均未准入；官方.cn首页web读取失败。本轮在正式取得原件前登记，未基于银票曲线对应股票收益选字段。',
'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_source_code_edits':0,
'independent_validation':False,'execution_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],
'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
OUT.mkdir()
for name,obj in [('protocol.json',protocol),('source_parent_hashes.json',[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p)} for p in parents])]:
    with (OUT/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
        json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
freeze={'registered_at':now,'protocol_sha256':sha(OUT/'protocol.json'),'source_parent_hashes_sha256':sha(OUT/'source_parent_hashes.json'),
'before_new_original_source_downloads':True,'before_E16_equity_labels_or_fits':True,'single_bounded_source_route':True}
with (OUT/'source_freeze.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    json.dump(freeze,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('E16来源前登记完成：锁定银行承兑汇票六个月国股转贴现；4入口、12后续官方请求、4目录搜索上限。')
print('未登记模型，未读取新股票标签，未修改研究模块源码。')
